verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community user noting they could delete their Shortwave account, which made switching back to Gmail low-risk. That implies basic account-level deletion. Another user wished for a denylist to keep sensitive mail from syncing to Shortwave's servers, which suggests there is no granular control over what data is retained. missing for 10: first-party documentation of data retention policies, user-configurable retention periods, per-message or selective exclusion from server sync, explicit controls over AI-processed data deletion, independent verification that account deletion purges server-side data.
